narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twenty folds gave only ten metres. We need thousands of folds to reach the Moon.
<bookmark mark='grow'/>Doubling is not slow for long. Each fold adds as much as all the folds before it.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Let us double and see where the stack really goes.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows thousands of folds; a short row of doubling arrows from 10.4 m appears and grows fast; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rows'/>To check, see that every row is twice the row above it.
<bookmark mark='moon'/>Then see that fold forty five is below the Moon and fold forty six is above it.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the full table; two check lines appear: each row is twice the row above; fold 45 is below the Moon, fold 46 is above

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the stack grows so slowly that thousands of folds are needed. Doubling from about ten metres passes the Moon after only twenty six more folds, so the bubble is struck.
